method_definitions.raw_da3: standalone frozen DA3METRIC output converted to metric depth as cached canonical depth * mean(fx,fy)/300; no BIM or GT scaling
method_definitions.raw_da3_canonical: cached standalone DA3METRIC canonical-focal output retained only to audit historical results that mislabeled it as raw metric depth
method_definitions.legacy_global_scale_q45: historical q=.45 BIM scale applied to cached DA3
method_definitions.legacy_bim_direct_q45: historical q=.45 scale plus registered local correction
method_definitions.robust_global_scale: frozen train-selected robust log-cap BIM scale applied to cached DA3
method_definitions.robust_bim_direct: robust global scale plus the unchanged registered local correction
method_definitions.bim_envelope: raw fixed-envelope render; standalone hit-support metrics and coverage only
method_definitions.coarse: model metric-scale input before learned local refinement; exact alias of live_scale for E2E checkpoints
method_definitions.iterative_scale_round_1: shared-weight residual-conditioned BIM/DA3 scale estimate after iteration 1, before local refinement
method_definitions.iterative_scale_round_2: shared-weight residual-conditioned BIM/DA3 scale estimate after iteration 2, before local refinement
method_definitions.iterative_scale_round_3: shared-weight residual-conditioned BIM/DA3 scale estimate after iteration 3, before local refinement
method_definitions.scale_plus_low: attention-scale output after the routed low-frequency log residual but before the detail log residual; frame residual is disabled for this staged ablation
